g.text: Inserting books into the hash map (small table, m = 8 buckets)
Real values: hashFunction(titre, auteur, 8) on the first 4 lines of GdeBiblio.txt. Each bucket is a linked list; a new book goes in FRONT.
8 buckets, each an empty list (head = NULL)
Start: every bucket is an empty list.
Hash says 2: book 0 becomes the head of bucket 2.
Also 2: book 1 goes in front, book 0 moves back.
Hash says 3: bucket 3 gets its first book.
Hash says 0: 4 books, 3 buckets used, 1 collision.
k = sum of title + author char codes
